description: Read the patient leaflet (ulotka) or the Summary of Product Characteristics (chpl) of a medicine from the register, one section at a time, e.g. chpl 4.2 for dosing, ulotka 3 for how to take it. Without section it lists the sections. A long section comes in parts: ask for part 2 and on while part < parts. Quote the text, do not add advice beyond it. apteka.online is a Polish online pharmacy: it sells only non-prescription products, ships only within Poland (medicines only by courier, not to parcel lockers or pickup points) and lists prices in PLN gross. Do not give medical advice. Medicine data comes from the Polish register of medicinal products (RPL) and the Ministry of Health refund announcement: prescription medicines are shown for information only and are not sold online, and refund prices are official maximum prices, not apteka.online prices.

part.description: Part of a long section, from 1 (default) to parts

section.description: Section number from get_medicine, e.g. 3 or 4.2; leave out to list the sections

slug.description: Medicine key from search_medicines or a /lek/{slug} URL, e.g. prestarium-10-mg-tabl-powl-10-mg-les
